passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
practicalCriteria: Every required field is completed, or marked not applicable with a written reason
Names for segments, services and prices are consistent across the plan
Every compliance item shows CHECKED with a source and date
Each financial assumption shows its basis and date
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: Plan submitted with a compliance item shown as CHECKED and no source
Plan submitted that implies a licence, registration or authority
Sample text, names or figures left in the completed plan
